program: Wingless corrective RSI tranche: prospective calibration of internal diagnostics into conservative future-data allocation
question: Can a calibration model frozen entirely from three already-sealed disjoint manifests convert existing Wingless internal diagnostics into a future-data allocation decision that beats equal allocation on a fifth unseen manifest, while falling back to equal allocation whenever historical transfer evidence is insufficient?
hypothesis: Build a fixed ridge calibrator from three historical manifests only: transfer manifest c79f09..., third manifest e46907..., and fourth manifest 974ecf.... Each historical example is one adjacent adaptation-budget interval. Frozen features are per-byte rates of baseline argmax changes, upper-budget changed-row margin sum, motif entries, motif exits, prediction-active motif churn, and retained-motif best changes. Label is sealed exact-hit marginal gain for that historical interval. Use ridge lambda=1.0 with intercept and no feature/threshold tuning. Estimate a conservative uncertainty radius by leave-one-manifest-out calibration: for every held-out historical manifest and every one of the ten fixed 1,744-byte allocation triples, compute predicted advantage vs equal and actual advantage vs equal; uncertainty_radius=max(0,max(predicted_advantage-actual_advantage)). On the fifth manifest, compute all diagnostics without opening the 582-byte evaluation slices, fit the full historical calibrator, score the same ten candidate allocations, choose the maximum predicted advantage with lexicographic tie-break, then require the selected candidate's predicted advantage to be strictly greater than uncertainty_radius under the full model AND under each of the three leave-one-manifest-out models. If any confidence predicate fails or the best candidate is equal allocation, freeze decision=FALLBACK_EQUAL. Otherwise freeze decision=REALLOCATE and the selected triple. Only after that frozen decision may fifth-manifest evaluation bytes be opened.

predecessor.eliminated_or_weakened_hypothesis: prediction-active motif churn by itself is sufficient to distinguish productive from zero-gain intervals
predecessor.strengthened_hypothesis: internal signals require cross-manifest calibration and explicit reliability estimation before controlling allocation

cause_effect_trace.observed_failure: R23 confidence-gated allocation lost 13 hits vs equal; R24 localized opportunity-cost error; R25 showed prediction-active churn AUC=0.5 and failed to separate productive from zero-gain intervals
cause_effect_trace.internal_diagnostic: existing baseline-change, margin, motif-entry/exit, active-churn, and retained-best-change observables
cause_effect_trace.attributed_cause: single handcrafted signal mappings are not sufficiently calibrated across manifests and can overpredict marginal value
candidate_corrective_mechanisms: mandatory equal-allocation fallback under insufficient confidence
cause_effect_trace.frozen_candidate_selection_rule: ridge lambda=1.0 plus historical worst-overprediction radius and unanimous positive advantage across full+LOO models
cause_effect_trace.exact_bounded_delta: replace the unexecuted R26 single-signal factorial with one prospective calibrator/fallback experiment; same substrate, capacity, candidate allocation set, total data budget, and authority
cause_effect_trace.qualification: bounded branch package, exact source identities, deterministic double run, full Go regression, exact READY_RESEARCH receipt
cause_effect_trace.held_out_result: fifth manifest sealed evaluation opened only after policy freeze
cause_effect_trace.retain_revert: policy is not retention-eligible after this run; negative/reallocation failure reverts to equal, supported result requires sixth-manifest replication before retention eligibility
cause_effect_trace.next_hypothesis: if supported, repeat unchanged calibrator/fallback rule on a sixth disjoint manifest; otherwise attribute calibration error without post-result coefficient tuning

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_model.target: sealed exact-hit marginal gain on historical manifests only
frozen_model.solver: deterministic Gaussian elimination with fixed pivot rule; fail invalid on singular/nonfinite solve
frozen_model.reliability: three leave-one-manifest-out ridge models plus full historical model
frozen_model.uncertainty_radius: max(0,max(predicted policy advantage - actual policy advantage)) across all 3 held-out historical manifests x 10 fixed policies
frozen_model.confidence_rule: chosen candidate predicted advantage > uncertainty_radius under full model and all 3 leave-one-manifest-out models

classification_rules.supported: valid, decision=REALLOCATE, selected allocation differs from equal, actual aggregate exact hits exceed equal by >=1, no selected domain falls below packet0 baseline, and all fixed budget/isolation/authority predicates pass
classification_rules.mixed: valid and decision=FALLBACK_EQUAL; conservative fallback behaved as designed but no unseen-data improvement was demonstrated
classification_rules.negative: valid, decision=REALLOCATE, and selected aggregate exact hits do not exceed equal or any selected domain falls below packet0 baseline
classification_rules.invalid: any parent, authority, manifest identity, historical calibration identity, feature/label boundary, model formula, LOO reliability calculation, candidate-set, fixed-total, deterministic replay, capacity, provenance, or accounting requirement fails

rsi_success_note: Even a supported R26 is only one prospective transfer. The policy becomes retention-eligible only after an unchanged replication on a different sixth manifest.

successor_if_supported.intent: repeat the unchanged calibration/reliability/fallback policy on a sixth disjoint manifest; only repeated support may make the policy retention-eligible

successor_if_mixed.intent: attribute why confidence was insufficient while preserving equal fallback and without lowering confidence thresholds post hoc

successor_if_negative.intent: attribute cross-manifest calibration error without post-result coefficient, feature, or threshold tuning

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not change historical manifests, fifth-manifest sources, features, ridge lambda, solver, uncertainty construction, confidence rule, candidate allocations, equal fallback, budgets, evaluator, thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.
